bcns Connect puts every tool your business runs on into one organized place for $200 a month with no setup fee, and it's the baseline everyone starts on. If you want something custom built on top, like an agent, an app, or a dashboard, a Deluxe build starts from $5,000 to set up plus $300 a month on top of Connect.

We can also work by the day if you'd rather have hands-on help with AI: consulting is $1,000 per day. All build pricing is a starting point, and we'll scope the exact number with you before any work begins.
